---
name: Feature request / 功能建议
about: Describe a use case and the improvement you need / 说明使用场景和希望改进的功能
title: "[Feature] "
---

<!-- You may answer in English or Chinese. 可用中文或英文填写，不必重复填写两种语言。 -->
<!-- This issue is public. Use fictional examples; do not include credentials, private chats, or personal data. -->
<!-- 这是公开 Issue，请用虚构示例，不要附凭据、私人聊天或个人信息。 -->

## What are you trying to do? / 你想完成什么？

Describe your use case and what currently gets in the way.
说明使用场景，以及现在遇到的不便。

## Suggested improvement / 希望怎样改进？

Describe the behavior you would like. You do not need to design the implementation.
描述希望出现的效果，不需要设计技术实现。

## Example / 举个例子

Give a short, fictional input and expected result.
用简短的虚构内容举例：输入什么，希望得到什么结果。

## Current workaround (optional) / 目前的替代办法（可选）

What do you do today, and why is it insufficient?
现在怎么处理，哪里不够方便？

## Context (optional) / 补充信息（可选）

Relevant client, package version, or existing feature; links to related issues are welcome.
相关客户端、包版本或已有功能；也可以附相关 Issue 链接。

Please check the [feature guide](https://github.com/cyuanxv/telegram-bot-mcp-server/blob/main/docs/FEATURES.md) for capabilities that may already be available with additional configuration. Submission does not guarantee a delivery date.
可先查[功能说明](https://github.com/cyuanxv/telegram-bot-mcp-server/blob/main/docs/FEATURES.md)，有些能力需要额外配置即可使用。提交建议不代表已承诺开发时间。
